title: Microsoft Viva: targeted audience surveys in the Copilot Dashboard
summary: Hold: the licensing field says Microsoft has not published an entitlement, although Microsoft documents access through existing Viva Pulse and Copilot licences. The recommendation to monitor individual leaders' survey frequency through Pulse reports also lacks supporting documentation. The roadmap facts, rollout notice, default state and listed configuration paths are supported.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model, licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The licensing model for this Viva Pulse capability is unknown because Microsoft has not published a licence for it.
claims.quote: Users with a Microsoft Copilot license have access to the full functionality of Viva Pulse to gather real-time feedback from their teams.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to included. Replace the unpublished-licence assertions and the licence question with: 'Microsoft documents full Viva Pulse functionality for users with a Microsoft Copilot licence. Dashboard integration requires Viva Suite, Viva Workplace Analytics and Employee Feedback, Viva Glint or Microsoft Copilot. No separate price or meter for targeted audience surveys is documented at the time of writing (November 2026).' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/pulse/setup-admin-access/granular-access-controls and retain the existing integration citation; keep the separate leader-access and tenant-eligibility qualifications.

claims.quote: To integrate Pulse survey results into the Copilot Dashboard, you must have at least one of the following subscription licenses: Viva Suite; Viva Workplace Analytics and Employee Feedback; Viva Glint; Microsoft Copilot

claims.claim: Under the Microsoft Copilot subscription, Pulse results for the Copilot impact template are automatically shared to the dashboard.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot (As part of this subscription, Viva Pulse survey results for the Copilot impact template are automatically shared to the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard).

claims.claim: No separate feature-specific price or meter for targeted audience surveys is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Pulse targeted audience surveys license pricing requirements; "targeted audience surveys" "price" "meter". Opened Pulse licensing, Copilot-impact integration and granular-access pages, and Microsoft's Viva plans and pricing; no targeted-survey rate or meter found.

claims.quote: Tenants with at least 50 Copilot licenses or at least 50 Viva Insights licenses also have access to agent-related insights, benchmarks, intelligent summaries, scoped group-level data, delegation support, and survey data (if available).

claims.claim: Active Copilot users are employees who performed at least one Copilot activity in the previous 28 days.
claims.quote: Active Copilot users: Employees who performed at least one Copilot activity in the previous 28 days.

claims.claim: The documented Viva feature access management controls are not available in GCC High or DoD.

claims.claim: The cited policy-creation path is Microsoft 365 admin center > Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy.
claims.quote: From the Microsoft 365 admin center, select Viva from the settings menu. Select the Settings tab and select Manage feature access. Select Create a policy.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaPulse -FeatureId <FeatureId> -Name <PolicyName> -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone creates a tenant-default disabling policy for the selected Pulse feature.
claims.quote: Pulse | VivaPulse ... Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId Reflection -Name UsersAndGroups -IsFeatureEnabled $false ... If you want to disable the feature for all users, use the -Everyone parameter instead.

claims.claim: The Copilot impact page gives Admin settings > Confidentiality as the minimum recipient setting location, unlike the in-app setup page.

claims.claim: The AI Administrator manages the Viva Insights exclusion list.

claims.where: Governance guidance: After rollout, first bullet

claims.fix: Delete 'using Viva Pulse reports' from the After rollout bullet, leaving the review as operational advice rather than attributing an unverified per-leader monitoring capability to Pulse reports.

claims.quote: Checklist: 'Review who holds the CxO or CxO-delegate role'; 'Check that the Viva Insights exclusion list is current'. Table: pre-built audience access and minimum recipient count only.
claims.fix: The checklist steps for reviewing dashboard role assignments and checking the Viva Insights exclusion list have no matching controls-table rows. The table therefore does not cover those checklist controls.
